note: One translation per Japanese sentence. Timings are estimated within each narration clip, not forced-aligned.

steps.title: Kamikoani, a mountain village
sentences: This is Kamikoani Village in Akita Prefecture.
Its population was 2,063 in the 2020 census.
The village stretches about 33 kilometers north to south, but mountains cover most of it.
Let’s look at where people live and work.

steps.title: Limited flat land and deep snow
sentences: Village documents classify 92.7% of the land as forest and wilderness.
Flat land and settlements lie along the Koani River and its tributaries.
Snow covers the village for about a third of the year, reaching two meters in southern and eastern mountain areas.
Despite its size, land available for homes and farming is limited.

steps.title: Population across ten census districts
sentences: We now look at population by census small area.
The map divides the village into ten districts.
Darker green means a larger population.
The color covers each entire district; green mountains are not necessarily residential areas.
Actual settlements are smaller and more scattered than these boundaries suggest.

steps.title: Okitaomote and Kosawada
sentences: In 2020, Okitaomote had the largest population, at 741.
Kosawada had 309; together, these two districts held about half the village’s population.
In 2000, Okitaomote had 1,245 residents and Kosawada had 437.
Even the larger districts continue to lose population.

steps.title: Different rates of decline
sentences: The rate of decline varies by district.
Minamizawa fell from 72 residents in 2000 to 23 in 2020, a drop of roughly 70%.
Fukudate fell from 221 to 179, a decline of about 20%.
Both are shrinking, but at different speeds.

steps.title: Jobs supported by national forests
sentences: Forestry historically supported this mountainous village.
Village records show 536 forestry workers in 1975.
That fell to 85 in 2000 and 35 in 2015.
Most worked in national-forest-related jobs; the village cites restructuring and a prolonged timber-industry slump linked to imported wood.
The forests remain, but far fewer people work in them.

steps.title: Scattered farmland, stretched farmers
sentences: Farming centers on rice grown on limited flat land, with buckwheat and soybeans also cultivated.
A fiscal 2024 document says the farmers taking over land have already reached their capacity.
Their fields remain scattered, rather than consolidated into efficient blocks.
Mountain terrain and winter snow removal add to the burden.

steps.title: Small-scale manufacturing
sentences: There is manufacturing, too.
Nihon Kikai Kogyo’s San-i plant in Obayashi, attracted by the prefecture in 1987, is listed as handling snow fences and multistory parking systems.
Akita’s 2021 manufacturing tabulation lists four village establishments—in food, wood, furniture and metal—with 41 workers in total.
This covers qualifying establishments, including those with at least four workers, and excludes sole proprietorships.

steps.title: How residents’ jobs have changed
sentences: This chart shows the jobs of people living in the village.
Employed residents fell from 1,494 in 2000 to 876 in 2020.
Manufacturing fell from 351 to 128, while agriculture, forestry, fishing and mining combined fell from 260 to 117.
In 2020, health care and welfare was the largest category, with 216 workers.
These are important jobs, but worker counts alone do not show what the village sells to earn income from outside.

steps.title: Commuting beyond the village
sentences: This chart includes residents who work outside the village.
In 2020, 313 of its 876 employed residents—about 36%—commuted to other municipalities.
Another 191 people commuted into Kamikoani.
The jobs supporting village life extend beyond its administrative boundaries.
The 128 residents in manufacturing and the 41 workers in qualifying local factories measure different populations.

steps.title: A population decline of nearly 40%
sentences: Let’s move through the population figures in five-year steps from 2000.
The total fell from 3,369 to 2,063, a decline of nearly 40%.
Residents aged 65 and over also fell, from 1,197 to 1,107.
But children under 15 fell much more sharply, from 363 to 117.
Even with fewer older residents, their share of the total population rises.

steps.title: Young people leaving, deaths exceeding births
sentences: In 2020, about 54% of residents were aged 65 or over.
The village’s population strategy identifies net outmigration in the late teens and early twenties, when people enter education or employment.
Its newsletter reports three births and 51 deaths in 2025.
Alongside people leaving for work, deaths exceeding births contribute to population decline.

steps.title: Changing work and life in a mountain village
sentences: Kamikoani’s scattered settlements have sustained life amid mountains and snow.
The loss of national-forest-related jobs is a change shared by forestry villages.
Young people leaving and deaths exceeding births also affect many depopulating areas.
Here, farming on limited land, small-scale manufacturing and commuting outside the village help sustain livelihoods.
As population falls, maintaining homes, settlements and the roads connecting them becomes a central challenge.
